description: Unique identifier for one order line; primary key and UPSERT conflict key
transformation_rule: Copied as-is from staging orders

description: Identifier of the customer who placed the order
transformation_rule: Copied as-is from staging orders

description: Identifier of the product ordered
transformation_rule: Copied as-is from staging orders

description: When the order was placed (UTC)
transformation_rule: Parsed to UTC datetime in staging

description: Customer's city at time of curation
transformation_rule: Trimmed and title-cased in staging; left-joined onto orders

description: Customer's loyalty/segment tier
transformation_rule: Left-joined onto orders from staged customers

description: Display name of the product
transformation_rule: Left-joined from the full product reference (existence-only, not price-filtered) so a product with a bad catalog price is still described correctly

description: Product category
transformation_rule: Flattened from nested JSON in staging; left-joined

description: Product brand
transformation_rule: Left-joined from staged product reference

description: Number of units ordered
transformation_rule: Validated in staging to be numeric and within 1 to 20; invalid rows quarantined before reaching curated

description: Price per unit at the time of this order, not the product's current catalog price
transformation_rule: Copied as-is from staging orders; intentionally NOT taken from the product catalog

description: Discount percentage applied to this order line
transformation_rule: Copied as-is from staging orders

description: quantity multiplied by unit_price
transformation_rule: Computed in curated transformation

description: gross_amount multiplied by discount_pct
transformation_rule: Computed in curated transformation

description: gross_amount minus discount_amount
transformation_rule: Computed in curated transformation

description: Order status
transformation_rule: Validated in staging against the allowed-status list; invalid rows quarantined

description: updated_at of the source order record this row reflects
transformation_rule: Copied from the staging orders row used to build this curated row

description: Identifier of the pipeline run that produced this row
source_field: Generated (Airflow run_id or CLI-generated run id)
transformation_rule: Stamped by src/common/audit.new_run_id(); consistent across all 4 stages of one run

description: When this row was processed by the curated transformation (UTC)
transformation_rule: Set via utc_now_iso() inside build_curated()

description: Deterministic SHA-256 hash of this row's business content, excluding pipeline_run_id and processed_at_utc
transformation_rule: Used as the UPSERT change-detection key: a rerun with unchanged business data leaves record_hash, and therefore the row, untouched

description: Business key for a customer; kept unique via latest-updated_at deduplication
transformation_rule: Deduplicated in staging; duplicate-version rows found during profiling (e.g. C00120) resolved by keeping the greatest updated_at

description: Business key for a product
transformation_rule: Deduplicated in staging (one duplicate found, P0300)

description: Human-readable reason a record was rejected, e.g. invalid_or_negative_unit_price or orphan_product_reference
transformation_rule: Assigned by staging/curated validation logic

description: Which dataset/stage produced this quarantined record
transformation_rule: Assigned by staging/curated validation logic
